notes.title: POPUCOM - Patch Notes 7/15 (V1.0.6)
notes.content:
Heya adventurers, 


Thank you so much for your continued interest and support.

To improve your game experience, we've just released a new update for POPUCOM. Please check the patch notes below.

*Older versions no longer support online play. Be sure to update your game!



▼New Feature: "Hardcore Adventurer" Mode

// With faster combat pace and increased difficulty, this mode offers more intense challenges! See if you can clear every battle without using continues!

- When enabled, heart bubbles dropped in combat will not pop when shot.

- Once combat ends, heart bubbles will automatically pop, and players can collect the released hearts.

- This mode can only be toggled through the Settings menu either from the Pancake or the Main Menu.



▼Optimized Controls: [Rollo the Bomb] & [Captain Kitty]

- Added quick summon for [Rollo the Bomb]. The default control is pressing the Left Stick (L3/LSB) on controllers, or the Alt key on keyboard. This control can be remapped in Settings.

- Added a [Captain Kitty sensitivity] option for keyboard & mouse mode in Settings. This allows players to adjust mouse sensitivity.

- Added new keyboard & mouse controls. Players can now press the Q and E keys to make Captain Kitty interact with the [Just Spin me] switches.



▼Stages & Enemies

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Windmill Meadow] stage, Polymu might not be considered defeated when pushed off the platform.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Ocean Rig] stage, Stubborn Plank might unexpectedly disappear, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in a certain part of the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, Prismatetras would not reset when thrown off a platform.

- Fixed an issue where, in a certain part of the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, the Cannon of Friendship would disappear during online co-op, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed a display issue with the Prismatetra's trajectory that could occur in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Solar Power Plant] stage, the bell for summoning the Goodiebot Balloon Bus might not be correctly displayed in the cockpit view.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, Prismatetras might occasionally not reset as expected.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Solar Power Plant] stage, the battle might be triggered early before entering the Ninjamu area.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Sunset Drilling Base] stage, players might not be able to throw Prismatetras to the opposite platforms under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Desert Arsenal] stage, certain actions might get the Kind Bear stuck at a platform, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in certain parts of the [Base of Evil Science] stage, the Color Sensor Switches failed to respond to the touch of players of the matching colors.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Base of Evil Science] stage, if the Stubborn Plank was placed vertically, the Color Sensor Platforms might remain active when players were not around the Color Sensor Switches.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Base of Evil Science] stage, high network lag might cause the Color Sensor Switches not to respond to the touch of players of the matching colors that stand on the Barrier Bots.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Arcade Monster] stage, adventurers might not be able to recover health when caught by Binka 2600's hands.

- Fixed an issue where, in party mode stage [Use Prismatetra to Navigate Through~], players could get Prismatetras to clip through metal mesh in edge-case scenarios.

- Fixed an issue where, in the third section of the [Check Out the Color Before You Jump!] stage, players might occasionally die when moving through Cloud Pads of their colors.

- Fixed an issue where, in party mode stage [Shield Up and Build a Bridge!], players might respawn at abnormal positions, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Battle for Meowtopia] mini-game, glitched enemies and projectiles might appear during combat, affecting subsequent gameplay.



▼Art & Visuals

- Optimized the cameras and animations for certain cutscenes of the [Power Nexus] stage.

- Fixed a shoe model clipping issue in the dialogue before the unlocking of the arcade room.

- Fixed an online mode issue that, under certain conditions, players could equip additional attire while wearing the [Academy Style] outfit.

- Fixed several UI display issues.



▼System

- Optimized the emote wheel controller controls with X- and Y-axis inversion enabled.

- Fixed an issue where one heart might be missing from either adventurer's health bar after both adventurers died and respawned in Story Mode.

- Fixed an issue where remapping the [Switch color] key in Settings might incorrectly trigger a conflict warning.

- Fixed an issue where players using controllers might not be able to select outfits after entering the shop and dismissing all pop-up prompts.

- Fixed an issue where pressing the D key on the stage selection screen of the [Volley-Boink] mini-game could cause the game to freeze.

- Fixed an issue where, in online play mode, the text for Player 2 Assist options was not correctly displayed in some languages.



▼Others

- Fixed the issue that the game would not launch properly on certain devices.

- Fixed an issue where, after completing mini-games in the arcade room, the Main Menu music might unexpectedly start playing and background music might be missing in Party Mode stages.

- Fixed an issue where, when playing Story Mode tutorials online and Player 2 had unlocked a sub weapon, Player 2's inputs could trigger the sub weapon switching sound effect even when the weapon did not appear in the UI.



—————————————————— 

Have feedback or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you. Reach us via the official website or email!  

- E-mail: popucom_cs@gryphline.com 

- Customer Service Center: Visit the official POPUCOM website, scroll to the bottom, and click [Contact Us] 



Looking for teammates or a place to chat about the game? Join our [Official Discord]: https://discord.gg/popucom

notes.title: POPUCOM Dev Team Q&A Special
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!


This is the POPUCOM dev team. 



POPUCOM is a multiplayer platformer adventure game. Our goal of creating POPUCOM is to offer unforgettable moments of pure happiness and enjoyment for everyone and their friends. 



Since the official launch of POPUCOM, we have been hard at work gathering feedback and suggestions from every adventurer. We're also doing our best to optimize and tweak the POPUCOM experience so that future updates can give everyone a smoother gaming experience and richer content. We're doing everything we can to live up to your expectations and trust in us. 



We thank everyone for their support and feedback, and hope that every adventurer will be able to create memorable and joyous moments with their POPUCOM teammates. 





Q: I keep running into issues of network lag and high ping. What should I do?

A: We've received your feedback and are very sorry that such issues have affected your POPUCOM experience. Prior to the publishing of this notice, we already released the V1.0.2 update for optimizing network configurations for those playing via Steam and alleviating issues of network fluctuations that may happen during certain situations. 



To tackle the network connection issues, the dev team has completed a round of optimizations for our network service nodes across the globe. 



We will also continue to monitor and troubleshoot all future feedback regarding network connections and do everything in our power to solve and improve network issues. 



Should network issues persist, try following these steps to solve them: 

(1) Visit this link to test your connection: https://d.gryphline.com

(2) If you cannot pass this test, try resetting your network and resetting your DNS to the default DNS. Please refer the following detailed guide:



\[For Windows 10 users]

1) Open Network & Internet settings: Right click on the network icon (lower-right corner of the taskbar) → Select "Open Network & Internet settings".

2) Open change adapter options: Click on "Change adapter options" on the left side of the screen.

3) Edit network connection properties: Find the network connection you're currently using (Ethernet, Wi-Fi, etc.) → Right click → Select "Properties"

4) Reset the DNS: Select "Internet Protocol Version 4 (TCP/IPv4)" → Click "Properties", select "Obtain DNS server address automatically", then Click "OK".



\[For Windows 11 users]

1) Open settings: "Windows key" + "I" to open "Settings" → Click "Network & internet"

2) Select your network connection: Click on the network connection you're currently using (Ethernet, Wi-Fi, etc.).

3) Open IP settings: Find the "DNS server assignment" → Click on the "Edit" button on the right side.

4) Set it to auto: In the pop-up window, select "Automatic (DHCP)", then Save the settings.



If you have performed these steps but the issue persists or you encounter abnormal network performances, please submit a problem feedback ticket. We will handle your ticket and our customer service team will do their best to follow up on your feedback!



>>> E-mail: popucom_cs@gryphline.com

>>> Customer Service Center: Visit the official POPUCOM website, scroll to the bottom, and click \[Contact Us]





Q: I am a Steam / Epic Games Store user. How do I link my SKLAND account / claim free cosmetic items from SKLAND?

A: Before POPUCOM launched, the dev team made a plan in case our Steam / Epic Games Store users cannot link their SKLAND account to claim the free cosmetic rewards. 



If you are one of these players, visit our POPUCOM \[Official Discord] for a special channel for claiming our free cosmetic rewards. Click here to join our \[Official Discord] to claim the \[Gentle Breeze & Oopa Slippers] redemption codes. Follow these steps to get the free cosmetic rewards: 



1) Visit our official POPUCOM Discord and find this channel "👕free-cosmetics-check-here👟", then copy the limited-time gift pack redemption codes.

2) Start the game, then follow this path: Settings → Game → Gift code, then paste in the redemption codes.



If you encounter any issues when trying to claim the rewards, contact us via modmail or our Discord staff. This rule also applies to any subsequent Discord events and we will optimize the process as necessary. Given the current limitations, this method of claiming giveaways may be a little convoluted, and we humbly apologize for any inconvenience caused.





Q: Is there any way to POPUCOM together with random adventurers?

A: Apologies, but the feature of instant matchmaking is not yet available. We have created a special channel on our \[Official POPUCOM Discord] that you can use to look for fellow adventurers along with voice chat rooms and other amenities. Join our Discord and party up for some POPUCOM adventures!

Join our \[Official Discord]





Q: I try to start POPUCOM on my Steam Deck but it keeps crashing. Can I actually play this game on the Steam Deck?

A: We immediately troubleshoot this issue upon receiving your feedback! Crashes on the Steam Deck are due to compatibility issues with our previous version. An emergency fix has been released with the V1.0.2 update. Adventurers should now be able to play POPUCOM on Steam Deck normally with this update. Some compatibility issues may persist. We are constantly working on more optimizations and fixes. 



We'd also like to thank our adventurers for notifying us of this issue. We will be doing our best to ensure an enjoyable POPUCOM experience on the Steam Deck.





Q: I came across controller compatibility issues while playing POPUCOM. Is there a fix for this?

A: If you encounter controller mapping issues while playing on Steam, try using the POPUCOM controller options, select \[Prohibit Steam Input], and then restart the game. 



For adventurers who cannot tick the box for agreeing to the terms of services with the controller, a fix is on the way in a future update. 



When you're in the Room preparation screen, you can use the Cancel action (by pressing R or Esc keys) to switch to controller input. Hot switching in the game is also supported by certain models of controllers. 



If you encounter other issues with your controller, feel free to provide us with the model of your controller and we will work on a fix to ensure its compatibility!





Q: Why is POPUCOM fixed to 60 fps?

A: Currently, we have to fix the highest framerate to 60 fps in order to provide a stable online gaming experience for adventurers of different platforms and to avoid screen stutters and other performance issues that may occur in specific scenarios. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this limitation. 



We also noticed comments and guides teaching adventurers how to "force change" the settings and unlock fps limitations. However, we do not recommend using them as such actions may lead to additional performance issues that you might not be able to fix or tweak on your own. Do note that the dev team is treating the fps feedback as a major issue and we're working around the clock to optimize high fps performances. 





Q: I'm experiencing lags/crashes. What should I do?

A: We're really sorry if our adventurers are experiencing issues with their POPUCOM experience. Optimization issue is a top priority for the dev team. 



1) Check if your device meets the minimum system requirements  >>>Click here to view \[system requirements]

2) Check if the game-installation path includes Asian or other special characters, and if the path is longer than 255 characters. 

3) Finally, check if you have pending graphics card driver updates. 



If your issue persists even after following the methods listed above, then follow the \[Game Log Acquisition Guide], locate your Game Log, and send it to us to help us troubleshoot your issue. 





Q: I'm stuck at the login screen of POPUCOM and I can't get in. None of the buttons appear either. What should I do?

A: Try following these steps: 

1) Check if the game-installation path includes Asian or other special characters, and if the path is longer than 255 characters. 

2) If the issue persists, find the settings.data file in the following path, and send it to our customer service team, then delete the settings.data file and try entering the game again to see if it works. Path to the settings.data file: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/HyperGryph/Popucom/Settings





Q: Party Mode is too short / not fun enough. I really need to party it up!

A: Currently, stage designs for Party Mode are catered towards adventurers who just got started on POPUCOM. Our concern is that players who haven't completed Story Mode and the relevant tutorials might stumble a bit when they start playing Party Mode directly. 



Now that we've received feedback concerning Party Mode stage designs, we now have plans to provide more engaging stages to enrich the Party Mode experience in future updates (for free)! And we are definitely looking forward to getting your feedback with our future updates for the Party Mode!  





——————————————————



As game developers, we place great importance on the voice of our players. We know that truthful and detailed feedback is a source of essential information that lets us effectively optimize and improve our work. 



Troubleshooting and analyzing certain issues may require us to communicate with you so we can get additional details. These details will help us locate the problem, come up with a solution, and fix it. We need all the details we can get, and we sincerely thank every adventurer who provided as much detailed information as they could. We shall continue to review and monitor the voice of the POPUCOM community on various social media platforms. We will also take a more proactive approach in responding to your feedback and trace the causes of various issues. That being said, we also hope everyone can directly contact us via our Discord, customer service, and other official channels. Direct contact will give us a more accurate picture of the issues, allow us to create better fixes that improve the overall gaming experience, and give us inspirations and ideas for future updates and optimizations. 



Once again, we thank everyone for your continued understanding and support! 



——————————————————

If you feel excited about the game, don't forget to join our \[Official Discord] to share and watch thrilling gameplay moments, team up with fellow adventurers, and use voice chat for more engaging co-op experiences.

 Official Release: June 1, 2025, 20:00 (PDT)


Release FAQ
We've also put together an FAQ to answer some of your questions about the pre-order and release. Feel free to check it out and share it with your friends!

Q: What languages are supported in the game?
A: The game supports 11 languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (Spain), German, French, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), and Italian.
You can switch languages in the [Settings] menu on the main screen.

Q: What's included in the launch version?
A: The official launch version of POPUCOM comes with the full game content, including:
[Story Mode] Main storyline stages for 2-player co-op
[Party Mode] More challenging stages for 3-4 player multiplayer. Recommended for players with Story Mode experience

Q: Does this game support online multiplayer?
A: PC players can play online multiplayer through [Online Mode]. To cross-play between different PC storefronts, use a [Room ID] to create or join a multiplayer room.

Q: Is there a launch bonus? How do I get it?
A: Yes! There's a limited-time launch bonus. Just log into the game during the event period to unlock it for free. The bonus includes 2 sets of outfits (6 pieces total):
[Hairstyle]: Soothing Breeze, Clean Look
[Attire]: Cozy Afternoon, Leisurely Holiday
[Footwear]: Morning Breeze, Eco-Warrior
Event Time: Official launch – June 15, 2025, 19:59 (PDT)

Q: How do I contact the customer support if I run into an issue?
A: You can contact us in 2 ways:
Email: popucom_cs@gryphline.com
Customer Service Center: Visit the official POPUCOM website, scroll to the bottom of the page, and click [Contact Us].



Looking for teammates or a place to chat about the game? Don't forget to join our [Official Discord]!

notes.title: NOTICE ON URGENT GAME ISSUES
notes.content:
If you encounter issues with the online mode, please try the following steps:

1. Open Windows Start Menu – Settings – Network & Internet – Change adapter options
2. Find the Virtual Network Adapter, right-click, and select Disable
3. If you don't see the Virtual Network Adapter, try keeping only Ethernet enabled by right-clicking on all other network adapters and selecting Disable

notes.title: POPUCOM NEXT FEST PLAYTEST GUIDELINES
notes.content:
Dear adventurers!

The Steam Next Fest October 2024 Edition is less than 5 hours away. Are you ready to team up and put your gaming skills to the test? Don't rush just yet. Before diving into the adventure, please take a moment to read through the playtest guidelines!

Q: What is POPUCOM?
A: POPUCOM is a 3D co-op platform adventure game. It features online or local co-op play for up to 4 players. In this game, you will team up with other players and journey through an unknown parallel world. You will face various enemies and use engaging items and techniques to eliminate threats and restore the world to its former glory. 
Outside the main gameplay, you can try out a selection of mini-games for a fun-filled session with your friends.

Q: When is the Next Fest demo available?
A: Oct 14, 10:00 AM - Oct 21, 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7)

Q: How do I access the Next Fest demo? What content does the demo include?
A: The demo is available for free on [PC]. To get the demo, please search [POPUCOM] on Steam to download [POPUCOM Demo]. 
The demo includes several Story Mode stages where you can try out the main weapon, 4 sub weapons, and a portion of the outfits and cosmetic options. All stages are designed for 2-player co-op and require about 2 - 3 hours to complete."
Please note that the game is still under development, so the demo version does not reflect the final quality of the game.

Q: What language options does the game provide?
A: We plan to add 11 language options to this game. They include:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (Spain), German, French, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), and Italian.
For the demo version, you can choose between different languages from the [Settings] menu on the main screen.

Q: What are the system requirements for the demo? Does the demo support controllers?
A: The demo can be played with Xbox, PlayStation DualSense, and PlayStation DualShock controllers. System requirements for the demo are as follows: 

 Windows 10/11 64-bit
 
Recommended: Intel Core i5-10600 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
Minimum: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
 
Recommended: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
Minimum: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 550
 8GB RAM or higher 
 15GB free space or higher, SSD Recommended

Q: Does this game support online multiplayer?
A: For the demo, you can use [Online Play] to play online multiplayer with your friends. Access [Story Mode] > [Online] from the main screen, then select [Create room] or [Join room] to start your online multiplayer session. 
Please note that we're still adjusting the online multiplayer feature, and this may cause unstable connection during online play sessions. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

Q: What are the release date, platforms, and retail price of POPUCOM?
A: After the demo event ends, we will continue polishing the game based on the demo's performance and player feedback. Details about the official release will be announced later through official news. Please stay tuned.

Q: Will my demo progress carry over to the official version?
A: No. Progress made in the demo will not carry over. 
After the demo period ends, we will adjust game content based on player experience and feedback. As such, the official version will differ from the demo and your game progress will therefore be reset.

Q: Can I stream the demo, create videos about it, or post demo content on social media platforms?
A: We encourage players to share their gameplay footage and thoughts during the demo period. You can post content in various formats, including text, screenshots, videos, and live streams. Feel free to choose your preferred format to share on social media. 
However, hacking or circulating the game's installation files or client are strictly forbidden. Illegitimate and/or infringement activities like datamining the installation files or client, unauthorized use of game assets, intentional defamation of the game, etc. are also not allowed. We reserve the right to take legal action against such behaviors.

Q: The game suddenly freezes, crashes, or does not respond to my inputs.
A: Please contact us via the customer service mailbox and provide the following information: 
- Your account info (Find your Steam ID by following these steps: While in the Steam client, click the avatar at the top right > Select "Account details" > Your Steam ID will be at the top of the page) 
- Device information (Right click the Start menu > Click Device Manager) 
- Description of the bug & Steps to reproduce the bug 
- Videos and/or screenshots 
- Game log (File name: Player.log. Path: C:\Users\xxx\AppData\LocalLow\Hypergryph\Popucom)

Q: How do I contact the customer service team?
A: You can contact us at: popucom_cs@gryphline.com


We've also published a special program. Click the video below to check it out.
[previewyoutube=C-rVSDeLu7M;full][/previewyoutube]

Have a great time with the demo. And don't forget to add POPUCOM to your wishlist!

notes.title: POPUU Comms Vol.1
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers! 

We've heard that you're already gearing up for the adventure. A notice beforehand: the weather on this planet of diverse landscapes is unpredictable, please ensure to be fully prepared before heading off! Today I will share intel from dev team's terminal about the frozen mystery zone—Polar Research Station!


Explore! Polar Research Station

Rumor has it that a mysterious energy lies beneath this desolate permafrost. Seeking for this new source, the evil energy corporation Startower invaded this area and built up Polar Research Station as a frontline base to start extensive energy research and exploitation.

Startower caused severe pollution to the environment and the indigenous people [Snowboo] were forced to fight for their home. They concentrated all fire on the research station to drive the intruders out of their land.

The battle finally ended up in Snowboo's triumph. Flags of victory atop the icy mountains, ice sculptures of the martyrs were made in memory of their heroic sacrifices and contributions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/a1552e9193f714ebd1c306b05f88addc328ee4f0.png

Alert! Pomus are coming!

As you venture forth, you will come across a diverse range of Pomus, each has a unique look, character and attack style.

For instance, some Pomus like to stack on their fellows' heads and together they become a [Stacko]. To secure attachment on their companions' heads, these pomus have grown antennae over time, making the structure of Stacko more stable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/53be91cb4f1681504ef747547f3c8420da973acc.png

Negative emotions fuel the destructive instincts of Pomus. They are driven by a greater incentive to attack as surroundings get worse. This explains why Pomus remain highly aggressive even in polar regions.

Some of the most hostile Pomus live on the man-made robots they defeated and evolve into [Mecha Pomus]. The [Cubos] you will encounter during the adventure is a member of the Mech Pomu family. While charging is their only way of attack, they are incredibly strong. Stay vigilant, adventurers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/c6a7de9708dfe5be97e6ffcc093a3162fd11b91f.png

Some Pomus were captured and transformed by Startower into a special species called [Pobbaman]. Each Pobbaman has distinct looks and behaviors, and is a bigger threat than regular Pomus. When you're up against Pobbamen, target their weaknesses and take them down in one go!

This Pobbaman in Polar Research Station can cause AOE damage with its "spinning" lengthy legs. So you got to find a way to shorten its legs, or else, if the legs keep on stretching, we'll be in serious 
trouble!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/19fbef14a4b331bad0a7205d97c1cd411b6ca0b0.jpg

Make your moves, adventurers!

To confront Pomus, Doctor Chun Bing has developed a specialized weapon for our adventurers—[Rainbow Popper]. This shooter fires compressed mimic Pomus with "Condensed Synthetic Pomu Gel" loaded within. When the mimic Pomus interact with a sufficiant quantity of real Pomus, it triggers a "Pomu Collapse Reaction" that will wipe out them.

Plus, the outfits you're wearing are [Custom Battle Suits]. They will change color to match your Rainbow Popper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/610faf3affb846551dce1920802a9be2f2a9c924.png

Given the powerful laser emitters set up by Startower at the Research Station, [Barrier Bot] will be joining you for support. As Barrier Bot unfolds, an energy shield is created to not just block lasers but also resist attacks from Pomus. Thus you got extra time to keep going!

With the help of the mechnical arms, you can do more than just fight. Adjust Barrier Bot to lift your companion up, so they get to places they normally can't!

Barrier Bot stands as your most reliable sidekick in the face of enemy attacks. As it inevitably takes hits while protecting others, you may see emotions on its face. Be sure to take good care of your pal, adventurers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/f8154ab8cb13116b89138d4894c10ec584a0e0a8.jpg

Last thing to remember, the polar region is just the tip of the iceburg in the world of planets. Judging from other info in the terminal, your adventure on this planet will sure be incredibly fulfilling and exciting!

Alright, that's all I've got for you, adventurers! I'm still working on deciphering other information in the dev team's terminal and fine-tuning the interstellar teleporter. It may take a while. So stay fit and keep in touch. Once everything's set, I'll give you a shout and we'll kick off this adventure together!
